headline: Quantum Space to List on NYSE Following SPAC Merger with Inflection Point
summary: Quantum Space, Inc. will list on the New York Stock Exchange upon completing its business combination with Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI, which will voluntarily delist from Nasdaq.
why: SPAC business combinations offer private companies access to public market equity capital. Listing shifts between major exchanges reflect structural changes in corporate governance and market liquidity.

impacts.name: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI
impacts.why: Inflection Point agreed to merge with Quantum Space and transfer its listing to the NYSE.
